page.content:
Sedanya Oskanian is a Bragatron 5,000 who appears in Cars. He is painted grey. He has blue eyes, a black grille, and grey rims. He belongs to The Autobahn Society, along with Heather Drifeng and Michelle Motoretta.

page.overview:
Who is Sedanya Oskanian?

Sedanya Oskanian is a Bragatron 5,000 who appears in Cars. He is painted grey. He has blue eyes, a black grille, and grey rims. He belongs to The Autobahn Society, along with Heather Drifeng and Michelle Motoretta.
